description:
By now, most avenues for cheap computer gear have been exhausted: Prime Days, eBay, even swapping gear in a parking lot. But there’s one place where you can find a true bargain: your local university campus.

It’s weird, right? Tuition and housing costs are absolutely skyrocketing, but the humble computing shop on campus sells gear — collected from students moving out, faculty, and staff — and resells it for super cheap. What most people don’t realize is that those bargains are available to you, the public, as well as students already paying tens of thousands of dollars per year.

title: Forget eBay. Your local university is a gold mine for cheap PC gear
